name: iristv
description: irisTV - Smart TV OS in Pure Node.js, Native macOS WKWebView, Live HLS Video & Real OS Controls

scripts.build:webview: mkdir -p irisTV.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos10.15 webview.swift -o irisTV.app/Contents/MacOS/iristv-webview -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -framework GameController
